message: Create a polished main menu for a Roblox adventure game called SKYBOUND. Use a cohesive sky-island adventure style with a deep navy background, warm ivory typography, teal accents, and restrained gold highlights. Include a strong game title, a primary Play button, and secondary Settings and Credits buttons. Add a small version label. Make the composition feel distinctive and premium, with clear visual hierarchy, generous spacing, consistent icons, subtle hover/press feedback, and smooth menu transitions. Settings should open a panel with music and sound toggles, and Credits should open a dismissible panel. Support desktop and mobile with readable text and comfortable touch targets. Generate the UI and preview so I can rate the result.
